help.title: Help
help.subtitle: The store and each agent's files on disk are two separate things — plus what each control does.
lines: the store    — canonical skills/rules/commands/subagents/MCP servers you've added; this is what gets synced out to every agent.
agent files  — whatever's already on disk for an agent (may exist before shaic ever touched it). 'agents discover' (CLI) lists these; 'Import' in a scope row pulls one into the store.
one row per agent, showing its worst status across every scope and content/MCP axis it supports.
Detail = open the agent   Content diff / MCP diff = preview before any write
Push / Pull sync the store; a secret-scan block asks for confirmation first
Initialize = setup wizard   Refresh = re-read status
the chips filter by kind   New item = add   Edit = change   Delete = remove and sync out immediately
Write preview (shown before anything is written)
Apply writes the listed changes   Cancel writes nothing
breaks the selected agent down by scope (Global / Project), each row showing both content and MCP status.
Content diff / MCP diff = preview that axis   Import to store = pull this scope's on-disk files in
Setup wizard (first run, or when no store exists)
type the git remote URL, Initialize = validate then clone/init it
